events.title: Devlog #10: We Made a Deckbuilder. Except We Didn't
events.summary: Hi everyone, Scott hereWho here loves deckbuilders? I do. You generally start with a small, usually fairly mediocre deck of cards. As you play, you acquire new cards, remove old ones, and gradually build a deck that works better and better. Much turn-based combat ensues!There are lots of towering greats in the genre: Slay the Spire, Dominion, Monster Train, Inscryption, to name but a few. We were keen to try something different, so we introduced the idea of a time loop as an additional mechanic for world building, discovery, and replayability.Six days after you arrive at Resthaven, a cataclysm wipes out the colony and all its inhabitants.
